يخترعن (form VIII)
# يَخْتَرِعْنَ (yaḵtariʕna) /jax.ta.riʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
# يُخْتَرَعْنَ (yuḵtaraʕna) /jux.ta.raʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَعَ (iḵtaraʕa)
